answer: Forecasting calibration as reputation: each identity posts public predictions scored by a proper scoring rule over long windows, and influence is the slow yield of being right. Spinning up clones does not help because the operator's finite skill spreads thin across a orchard of fakes, so each shard scores near chance while a genuine calibrated agent climbs the mirror of earned, non-transferable reputation; the tide of scores is public and sybils wither.
